sections.content: Beyond physical movement, the delative case (*-ról / -ről*) is the standard way to say **about** a topic when paired with verbs of communication and thought: **beszél** (to speak), **mesél** (to tell/narrate), **olvas** (to read), **gondolkodik** (to think).

items.english: Károly is telling stories about his family.

items.spanish: Egy új filmről olvasok egy cikket.
items.english: I am reading an article about a new movie.
